info.title: Showpass Organizer Holds API
info.description: Read held baskets and dynamic hold metadata with scoped organizer API keys.

get.description: Reads held baskets in the organization bound to the key. Requires both Box Office Sales and Manage Holds, or All Access. Sellers see baskets assigned to them unless they have Manage All Holds or All Access. Treat customer details and hold URLs as sensitive. Basket contents and expiry can change between requests.

parameters.name: event_id

parameters.description: Page requests are independent and may reflect intervening edits.

parameters.description: Page requests are independent and may reflect intervening edits.

VenueBasedTicketBasket.description:
Validate venue-side basket mutations before purchase or terminal handoff.

The serializer binds active venue, seller, and session context, reuses shared basket validation, then adds box-office
guards for seller visibility, scan codes, seat/location permissions, discounts and credits, terminal checkout state,
resale and donation payment types, shipping/billing, custom packages, and protection-token validation.
